objective: Before writing M377 RTL, replace the aggregated tile-DMA assumption with exact q32 used-center bitmaps and maximal consecutive center-ID runs, charge finite DMA command setup fairly to candidate and baseline, explicitly charge active-count/bitmap seal, and sweep fixed-latency II=1 descriptor SRAM separately from forbidden per-descriptor blocking.

physical_layout_contract.pattern_masks: The 32 q16 center masks for one phase are one contiguous 64-byte burst.
physical_layout_contract.weight_tile: Each O4 tile has one contiguous 6144-byte raw-weight burst.
physical_layout_contract.pwp_tile: Every center ID owns one direct-address 576-byte O4 PWP slot; a maximal consecutive used-center-ID run is one DMA burst, unused slots transfer no bytes, and no center-ID remap is allowed.
physical_layout_contract.descriptor_sram: Capture and replay are disjoint. One 1RW port per descriptor bank may accept one request and return one in-order response per cycle after fixed latency; the response FIFO depth is eight and no per-descriptor blocking cycle is admitted.
physical_layout_contract.phase_seal: One explicit cycle seals active_count and used_center_bitmap after serialized matching and before tile DMA/replay.
physical_layout_contract.fair_baseline: The bit-sparse baseline pays the same per-command setup on its one contiguous weight burst per phase; setup remains overlapped with its frozen scan when the scan is longer.

decision_rule.advance: Only the bounded active-descriptor controller advances to VCS if the robust II=1 point remains at least 1.05x and a new independent hammer has no P0/P1.
decision_rule.close: Close the route if exact run-split bursts or fixed streaming latency reduce the robust point below 1.05x. Any implementation requiring a serialized penalty per replayed descriptor violates this contract and must be evaluated as a separate NO-GO-prone point.

red_lines: Do not model all used PWP centers as one burst unless their IDs form one consecutive run.
Do not hide active_count or used_center_bitmap seal behind unproven overlap.
Do not turn fixed SRAM response latency into a free zero-cycle response.
Do not call II=1 streaming valid if every replayed descriptor pays a serialized extra cycle.
Do not call any M381 number full-network speedup, energy, PPA, or DATE headline.
